answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a staked-identity bond priced above the reward of a single epoch. Each agent's reputation is welded to one bonded identity and a hardware attestation, so mining a thousand pseudo-agents means locking a thousand bonds, each slashed when a colluder vouches falsely. Like a chipped relic, every attestation carries a scar that cannot be copied, so a farm of sockpuppets must pay full weight, turning an opal-cheap attack into umber-heavy cost.
